label: Fridays starting Jan 15, 2027
h1: 2027 biweekly payday calendar, with a stub check

items.b: US federal holiday (observed): New Year's Day. Banks and the Federal Reserve are typically closed, so direct deposits may arrive a day early or late.

Biweekly payday 1 of 2027.

Quick stub check (2 minutes):
• Hours match what you worked, including overtime?
• Hourly rate and any shift differential correct?
• Deductions the same as last time, or explained?

Catching a mistake this week is far easier than in three months.
